The peer is never greylisted, so the growth continues toward OOM.

articles.title: GHSA: mail-parser: One hostile attachment aborts `write_attachments()` and silently drops the rest of the batch
articles.summary:
### Impact

`write_attachments()` called `_safe_attachment_filename()` and `write_sample()` inside its loop
with no guard, so a single crafted attachment raised out of the whole save. Every attachment
**after** the malicious one was silently never written, with no error surfaced to a caller that
catches only `MailParserError`.
